notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one land.

description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Second Chance triggers, causing you to sacrifice it and to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Tameshi by paying {3}{W} and returning a land you control to its owner's hand.
Tameshi triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Tameshi ability, returning Second Chance from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Play any land from your hand.
Repeat each turn.
